collocations: a useful invention; the invention of the telephone; a recent invention
commonMistake: invention 是可数名词，动词是 invent，发明者是 inventor；不要把 invention（发明物/发明行为）误写成形容词 inventive。

example.english: The students presented an invention that saves water in the garden.
example.chinese: 学生们展示了一项能节约花园用水的发明。

application.prompt: The new device that cleans beach sand is an impressive ___. A. invention B. inventor
application.solution: A。解析：invention 指“发明物”；inventor 指“发明者”，本句说的是新设备。

collocations: digital camera; take a photo with a camera; camera lens
commonMistake: camera 是可数名词；“用相机拍照”可说 take a photo with a camera，不说 make a photo by camera。

example.english: I used my camera to photograph the birds in the park.
example.chinese: 我用相机拍下了公园里的鸟。

application.prompt: Lena zoomed in and took a clear picture with her ___. A. photography B. camera
application.solution: B。解析：相机是 camera；photography 表示“摄影”这门活动，不是可握持的设备。

collocations: laptop screen; laptop battery; work on a laptop
commonMistake: laptop 可数，复数 laptops；它是电脑设备，不等于 paper notebook（纸质笔记本）。

example.english: My laptop battery lasted through the whole train journey.
example.chinese: 我的笔记本电脑电池撑过了整段火车旅程。

application.prompt: I saved the presentation on my ___ before the classroom computer was turned off. A. laptop B. lap
application.solution: A。解析：能保存演示文稿的便携电脑是 laptop；lap 指膝部。

collocations: travel by high-speed train; a high-speed train station; high-speed rail
commonMistake: high-speed 作复合形容词时加连字符并放在 train 前；乘坐某种交通工具常用 by train。

example.english: The high-speed train reached the next city in less than an hour.
example.chinese: 高速列车不到一小时就到达了下一个城市。

application.prompt: We chose a ___ to travel between the two cities quickly. A. high-speed travel B. high-speed train
application.solution: B。解析：train 是可乘坐的列车；high-speed train 指“高速列车”，符合两城间快速出行的语境。

collocations: super idea; super popular; a super-fast computer
commonMistake: super 是非正式形容词，常放在名词前或 be 后；它不代替副词 very 去修饰动词。

example.english: The science fair was super, and we learned a lot from the exhibits.
example.chinese: 科学展览会棒极了，我们从展品中学到了很多。

application.prompt: The new library is ___ popular with students because it stays open late. A. superb B. super
application.solution: B。解析：super 在非正式英语中可作副词修饰 popular，表示“非常受欢迎”；形容词 superb 不能这样修饰另一个形容词。

collocations: wear sunglasses; a pair of sunglasses; sunglasses case
commonMistake: sunglasses 通常以复数形式出现；说“一副”用 a pair of sunglasses，不能说 a sunglasses。

example.english: He wore sunglasses to protect his eyes from the bright sun.
example.chinese: 他戴着太阳镜保护眼睛不受强光刺激。

application.prompt: The sun was bright, so Mei put on a pair of ___. A. sunglass B. sunglasses
application.solution: B。解析：a pair of 后接复数 sunglasses；sunglass 单数不用于通常的“太阳镜”义。

collocations: press a button; sew on a button; button your coat
commonMistake: button 作名词指按钮或纽扣；作动词表示“扣上”，button up 可指扣好衣服。

example.english: Press the green button to start the washing machine.
example.chinese: 按绿色按钮启动洗衣机。

application.prompt: To turn on the recorder, press the red ___. A. button B. bottom
application.solution: A。解析：recorder 上用于操作的按键是 button；bottom 表示“底部”。

collocations: by itself; the machine itself; enjoy itself
commonMistake: itself 是 it 的反身代词，用于指物或动物；反身代词不能代替普通宾格 it 作及物动词宾语。

example.english: The robot can return to its charging station by itself.
example.chinese: 机器人能自己返回充电站。

application.prompt: The door closed ___ when the wind pushed it. A. it B. itself
application.solution: B。解析：主语 the door 与动作主体相同，需用反身代词 itself；it 不能表示“门自己”。

grammar: 短语 数以百计；许多
collocations: hundreds of stars; hundreds of people; two hundred pages
commonMistake: 确切数字前 hundred 不加 s 且不接 of；表示不确定的大量时用 hundreds of。

example.english: Hundreds of visitors came to see the new science centre.
example.chinese: 数百名参观者来参观新科学中心。

application.prompt: The museum welcomed ___ schoolchildren during the holiday week. A. hundreds of B. two hundreds
application.solution: A。解析：没有确切数字时用 hundreds of 表示“数百名”；two hundreds 结构错误。

collocations: a 3D printer; printer paper; connect a printer to a computer
commonMistake: printer 是由 print 加 -er 构成的可数名词，指打印设备或印刷机构；动词是 print。

example.english: The printer ran out of paper just before we printed the maps.
example.chinese: 我们打印地图前，打印机恰好没纸了。

application.prompt: The office bought a colour ___ to make copies of the posters. A. printing B. printer
application.solution: B。解析：make copies 的设备是 printer（打印机）；printing 是“印刷/打印”这一行为或行业。

collocations: produce electricity; produce food; produce a report
commonMistake: produce 是动词，名词是 production；作“农产品”时 produce 通常作不可数集合名词。

example.english: This farm produces enough vegetables for three local schools.
example.chinese: 这个农场生产的蔬菜足够供应三所当地学校。

application.prompt: The factory can ___ 500 bicycle helmets each day. A. production B. produce
application.solution: B。解析：can 后接动词原形 produce，表示“生产”；production 是名词。

collocations: save a file; open a file; a file on the computer
commonMistake: file 在计算机语境中是可数名词；file 也可作动词表示归档，复数 files 需加 s。

example.english: Please save the file before you close the program.
example.chinese: 关闭程序前请先保存文件。

application.prompt: I attached the report as a PDF ___ to the email. A. file B. folder
application.solution: A。解析：PDF file 是电子文件；folder 通常指存放文件的文件夹。

grammar: n. 塑料；adj. 塑料制的
collocations: plastic bottle; plastic waste; made of plastic
commonMistake: plastic 作材料名词通常不可数；作形容词时修饰名词。塑料瓶常说 a plastic bottle，而不是 a plastic。

example.english: Our class collected plastic bottles for recycling.
example.chinese: 我们班收集塑料瓶进行回收。

application.prompt: The lunch box is light because it is made of ___. A. plastic B. plastics
application.solution: A。解析：材料义 plastic 通常不可数；made of plastic 是“由塑料制成”。

collocations: invent a machine; invent a story; invent a new method
commonMistake: invent 强调创造以前不存在的东西；名词 inventor 指发明者，invention 指发明物或发明行为。

example.english: The engineer invented a simple tool for opening jars.
example.chinese: 这位工程师发明了一种简单的开罐工具。

application.prompt: Who ___ the first practical telephone? A. invention B. invented
application.solution: B。解析：问“谁发明了”要用过去式动词 invented；invention 是名词。

collocations: answer the telephone; telephone number; telephone sb
commonMistake: telephone 作动词时直接接人，不用 telephone to sb；现代语境也常用 phone/call。

example.english: The telephone rang while Dad was cooking dinner.
example.chinese: 爸爸做晚饭时电话响了。

application.prompt: If you arrive late, ___ the coach and explain the delay. A. telephone B. telephone to
application.solution: A。解析：telephone sb 表示“给某人打电话”，后面不加 to。

collocations: suppose that; be supposed to do; I suppose so
commonMistake: suppose 可引导宾语从句；be supposed to do 表示“应该做”，不能漏掉 be。

example.english: I suppose the museum will be less crowded on Tuesday.
example.chinese: 我想博物馆星期二会没那么拥挤。

application.prompt: I ___ the train is delayed because the station board shows a later time. A. supposition B. suppose
application.solution: B。解析：suppose 在这里作谓语，表示“我猜想”；supposition 是名词。

word: be supposed to do / be sth
grammar: 短语 应该做；按规定是
collocations: be supposed to arrive early; be supposed to be quiet; what are we supposed to do?
commonMistake: 结构为 be supposed to + 动词原形；be supposed to be 后接名词或形容词。

example.english: Visitors are supposed to keep their voices low in the reading room.
example.chinese: 参观者在阅览室里应当轻声说话。

application.prompt: According to the notice, cyclists ___ wear helmets on this road. A. are supposed to B. suppose
application.solution: A。解析：are supposed to wear 表示“应当佩戴”；notice 说明的是规则，不是骑车者的猜测。

collocations: a bicycle wheel; steering wheel; a wheel of cheese
commonMistake: wheel 可指车辆的轮子或方向盘；wheels 是复数。短语 wheel of cheese 中 wheel 指圆轮状的一整块奶酪。

example.english: One wheel came loose, so we stopped the cart.
example.chinese: 一个轮子松了，所以我们停下了手推车。

application.prompt: The mechanic replaced the damaged front ___ of the bicycle. A. wheel B. whole
application.solution: A。解析：自行车前轮是 wheel；whole 意为“完整的”，发音相近但词义不同。

collocations: eastern China; the eastern coast; Eastern Europe
commonMistake: eastern 是形容词，常指某地区的东部；the east 作名词表示“东方”，不要用 east 直接修饰名词。

example.english: Many fishing villages lie along the eastern coast of the island.
example.chinese: 这座岛的东海岸分布着许多渔村。

application.prompt: The sun rose over the ___ hills at dawn. A. east B. eastern
application.solution: B。解析：hills 前需要形容词 eastern；east 作名词，不能直接这样作定语。

collocations: a layer of paint; several layers of clothing; the top layer
commonMistake: layer 是可数名词，常用 a layer of + 材料；多层用 layers。

example.english: A thin layer of ice covered the pond overnight.
example.chinese: 一夜之间，池塘表面结了一层薄冰。

application.prompt: The baker spread a final ___ of cream between the cakes. A. layer B. level
application.solution: A。解析：夹在蛋糕之间的一层奶油是 layer；level 更常指高度或水平。

collocations: frozen food; frozen lake; be frozen solid
commonMistake: frozen 是 freeze 的过去分词，也可作形容词；比较级不是 more freeze，动词过去式是 froze。

example.english: We found the lake frozen after three nights below zero.
example.chinese: 连续三个夜晚气温低于零度后，我们发现湖面结冰了。

application.prompt: The vegetables stayed fresh in the ___ section of the fridge. A. freezing B. frozen
application.solution: B。解析：冰箱里的冷冻区称 frozen section；此处需要形容词 frozen 修饰 section。

collocations: ice melts; melt butter; melt in the sun
commonMistake: melt 可作不及物动词（冰融化）或及物动词（融化黄油）；过去式和过去分词均为 melted。

example.english: The snow began to melt when the afternoon sun came out.
example.chinese: 午后太阳出来时，积雪开始融化。

application.prompt: Leave the chocolate near the heater and it will ___. A. melt B. melted
application.solution: A。解析：will 后接动词原形 melt；句子表示巧克力将会融化。

collocations: water pipe; a pipe under the sink; a pipe leaks
commonMistake: pipe 可指输送水或气体的管道，也可指烟斗；地下管道不等于 wire（电线）。

example.english: A plumber repaired the pipe beneath the kitchen sink.
example.chinese: 水管工修好了厨房水槽下面的管道。

application.prompt: Clean water flows to each apartment through a large ___. A. wire B. pipe
application.solution: B。解析：输送水的设施是 pipe；wire 用于导电或传递信号。

collocations: the tourism industry; tourism income; promote tourism
commonMistake: tourism 是不可数名词，形容词为 tourist（游客的）或 touristic（旅游相关的）；不能说 many tourisms。

example.english: Tourism provides jobs for many families on the island.
example.chinese: 旅游业为岛上的许多家庭提供了工作。

application.prompt: The new airport has helped the island's ___ grow. A. tourism B. tourist
application.solution: A。解析：岛屿发展的行业是 tourism（旅游业）；tourist 指游客。

collocations: economic growth; economic development; economic problem
commonMistake: economic 是形容词，名词是 economy；economical 表示“节省的”，两者不可混淆。

example.english: The report describes the economic changes in the region.
example.chinese: 报告描述了这个地区的经济变化。

application.prompt: The city is planning new projects to support ___ growth. A. economy B. economic
application.solution: B。解析：growth 前需要形容词 economic（经济的）；economy 是名词。

grammar: v. 获得；取得；n. 增加；收益
collocations: gain experience; gain weight; a gain in confidence
commonMistake: gain 可表示逐步获得经验、优势或体重；gain knowledge 不等同于 win knowledge，后者搭配不当。

example.english: Working with the team helped me gain valuable experience.
example.chinese: 和团队合作让我获得了宝贵的经验。

application.prompt: By volunteering at the clinic, Amir hopes to ___ experience in healthcare. A. gain B. win
application.solution: A。解析：gain experience 是“获得经验”的常用搭配；win 通常用于比赛获胜。

collocations: in reality; face reality; turn a dream into reality
commonMistake: reality 是可数或不可数名词，形容词为 real；in reality 表示“事实上”，不要写成 in the reality 表示抽象现实。

example.english: In reality, the tiny island is home to hundreds of birds.
example.chinese: 事实上，这座小岛是数百只鸟的家园。

application.prompt: The film looked like science fiction, but it was based on ___. A. real B. reality
application.solution: B。解析：based on reality 表示“以现实为基础”；real 是形容词，不能放在介词 on 后作名词。

collocations: traditional papermaking; papermaking process; papermaking workshop
commonMistake: papermaking 是由 paper 和 making 构成的名词；英语中通常连写，不写成 paper making 作这一工艺名称。

example.english: The museum showed how papermaking developed over many centuries.
example.chinese: 博物馆展示了造纸工艺数百年来的发展。

application.prompt: Visitors can watch the ancient ___ process in the village workshop. A. papermaking B. paper-made
application.solution: A。解析：papermaking process 指“造纸工艺”；paper-made 不表示这项工艺。

grammar: adj. 负有责任的；作为原因的
collocations: be responsible for a task; responsible for the damage; a responsible decision
commonMistake: responsible 后接 for；名词是 responsibility，副词是 responsibly。

example.english: Each group is responsible for cleaning its own work area.
example.chinese: 每个小组负责清理自己的工作区域。

application.prompt: The captain is ___ for checking that everyone wears a life jacket. A. responsibility B. responsible
application.solution: B。解析：be responsible for 表示“负责”；is 后需要形容词 responsible。

grammar: 短语 是某事的原因；对某事负责
collocations: be responsible for the delay; be responsible for a project; hold sb responsible for sth
commonMistake: responsible for 后接名词或动名词；表示造成某结果时，主语可以是人或事物。

example.english: Heavy rain was responsible for the delay of the outdoor concert.
example.chinese: 大雨导致户外音乐会延期。

application.prompt: The broken cable was ___ the power cut in the building. A. responsible for B. responsible of
application.solution: A。解析：be responsible for 表示“是停电的原因”；responsible 后不接 of。

collocations: rapid growth; a rapid change; rapid progress
commonMistake: rapid 是形容词，副词是 rapidly；快速增长可说 rapid growth 或 grow rapidly。

example.english: The rapid rise in temperature melted the snow on the road.
example.chinese: 气温迅速上升使路上的积雪融化。

application.prompt: The patient made a ___ recovery after receiving treatment. A. rapidly B. rapid
application.solution: B。解析：recovery 前用形容词 rapid 作定语；rapidly 是副词。

grammar: n. 形状；v. 塑造；使成形
collocations: in the shape of a circle; shape the future; shape clay
commonMistake: shape 作名词指外形，作动词可表示塑造；be in good shape 表示身体状况良好，不等于 have a good shape。

example.english: The potter shaped the wet clay into a small bowl.
example.chinese: 陶艺师把湿黏土塑成了一个小碗。

application.prompt: The artist used a knife to ___ the soft wood into a bird. A. shape B. shape of
application.solution: A。解析：shape sth into 表示“把某物塑造成”；shape of 后需跟名词，不能直接接 the soft wood。

collocations: a bronze statue; bronze medal; made of bronze
commonMistake: bronze 作材料名词通常不可数；bronze medal 指铜牌，medal 是奖牌本身。

example.english: The museum displays a bronze statue from the ancient city.
example.chinese: 博物馆展出了一尊古城遗留下来的青铜雕像。

application.prompt: The old bell is heavy because it is made of ___. A. bronzed B. bronze
application.solution: B。解析：made of bronze 表示“由青铜制成”；bronzed 是形容词，常表示晒成古铜色的。

collocations: glassware; kitchenware; bronze ware
commonMistake: ware 常用于复合词表示某类商品或器皿；单独的 ware 常作集合名词，不通常写成 a ware。

example.english: The shop sells handmade pottery and other local ware.
example.chinese: 这家商店出售手工陶器和其他当地制品。

application.prompt: Plates, bowls and cups made from clay are examples of pottery ___. A. ware B. wear
application.solution: A。解析：pottery ware 指陶制器皿或陶器制品；wear 是“穿戴/磨损”。

collocations: a stone wall; a stone bridge; throw a stone
commonMistake: stone 作材料名词时可不加冠词（made of stone）；作一块具体石头时是可数名词。

example.english: The children followed a narrow stone path through the garden.
example.chinese: 孩子们沿着一条狭窄的石径穿过花园。

application.prompt: The old bridge is built of ___, not wood or metal. A. stony B. stone
application.solution: B。解析：built of stone 表示“用石头建成”；stone 在此作材料名词，stony 通常是形容词。

collocations: jute fibre; a jute bag; grow jute
commonMistake: jute 是通常不可数的植物纤维材料；由黄麻制成的袋子可说 a jute bag。

example.english: The farmer carried vegetables in a strong jute bag.
example.chinese: 农民用结实的黄麻袋装蔬菜。

application.prompt: This reusable shopping bag is made from ___. A. jute B. juice
application.solution: A。解析：制作袋子的植物纤维材料是 jute（黄麻）；juice 是饮料。

collocations: dietary fibre; natural fibre; fibre content
commonMistake: fibre 是英式拼法，美式拼写为 fiber；通常不可数，指单根纤维时才可数。

example.english: Oats are a good source of dietary fibre.
example.chinese: 燕麦是膳食纤维的良好来源。

application.prompt: Whole-grain bread contains more dietary ___ than white bread. A. fibrous B. fibre
application.solution: B。解析：dietary fibre 是“膳食纤维”；fibrous 是形容词，不能直接放在 dietary 后。

collocations: an expensive watch; too expensive to buy; expensive for a student
commonMistake: expensive 的反义词是 cheap；表示“某物对某人来说很贵”可说 expensive for sb，不能说 expensive to sb。

example.english: The museum shop sells beautiful but expensive handmade toys.
example.chinese: 博物馆商店出售精美但价格昂贵的手工玩具。

application.prompt: The camera is too ___ for me to buy with my savings. A. expensively B. expensive
application.solution: B。解析：too 后接形容词 expensive，构成 too expensive to buy；expensively 是副词。

collocations: a police officer; a government officer; speak to an officer
commonMistake: officer 指担任职务的人；office 指办公室或职务，不能把 officer 当作房间。

example.english: A park officer explained why the nesting area was closed.
example.chinese: 一名公园管理人员解释了为什么鸟类筑巢区暂时关闭。

application.prompt: The ___ checked our tickets before we entered the station platform. A. officer B. office
application.solution: A。解析：检查车票的人是 officer（工作人员/官员）；office 是办公室或职务。

collocations: a pottery workshop; attend a writing workshop; workshop tools
commonMistake: workshop 可指制作或修理物品的场所，也可指集中学习的讲习班；参加课程用 attend a workshop。

example.english: I joined a weekend workshop to learn how to make paper lanterns.
example.chinese: 我参加了周末讲习班，学习制作纸灯笼。

application.prompt: At the pottery ___, visitors can watch bowls being made by hand. A. workshop B. worksheet
application.solution: A。解析：制作陶器的场所是 workshop（作坊）；worksheet 是练习单。

collocations: none of the students; none left; none of them
commonMistake: none of 后可接复数名词或代词；后接可数复数时，谓语可用单数或复数，语意侧重整体或个体。

example.english: None of the milk was left after breakfast.
example.chinese: 早餐后牛奶一点也没剩。

application.prompt: We checked all five batteries, but ___ of them worked. A. no B. none
application.solution: B。解析：none of them 表示“它们没有一个”；no 后需直接修饰名词，不能接 of them。

grammar: adj. 理想的；n. 理想；典范
collocations: an ideal place; ideal for a picnic; a role model and ideal
commonMistake: ideal 作形容词常用 ideal for；作名词可表示理想或典范，不要把 idea（想法）当作它的同义词。

example.english: The quiet beach is an ideal place to watch the sunrise.
example.chinese: 这片安静的海滩是观看日出的理想地点。

application.prompt: With shade, clean water and easy access, the park is ___ for a family picnic. A. idea B. ideal
application.solution: B。解析：be ideal for 表示“很适合”；此处说明公园适合家庭野餐。

grammar: n. 树皮；狗吠声；v. 吠叫
collocations: tree bark; a dog's bark; bark at a stranger
commonMistake: bark 作动词表示狗吠，名词可指树皮或吠声；树皮不可说 the bark of a tree 用在“吠声”义以外，需结合语境。

example.english: The gardener removed loose bark from the young tree.
example.chinese: 园丁清除了小树上松动的树皮。

application.prompt: The squirrel hid its food under the rough ___ of the oak. A. bark B. branch
application.solution: A。解析：树干外层粗糙部分是 bark（树皮）；branch 是树枝。

grammar: adj. 某些；确定的；pron. 某些人或物
collocations: certain students; be certain that; a certain amount of time
commonMistake: certain 作“某些”修饰名词时不等于 all；be certain of/about 表示确信，certainly 是副词。

example.english: Certain birds return to this wetland every winter.
example.chinese: 某些鸟类每年冬天都会回到这片湿地。

application.prompt: ___ students may leave early if their parents have signed the form. A. Certainly B. Certain
application.solution: B。解析：students 前用形容词 certain，表示“某些学生”；certainly 是副词。

collocations: suitable for children; suitable clothes; be suitable to do sth
commonMistake: suitable 常与 for 连用，suit 是动词“适合”；不能说 suitable to someone 表示“适合某人”。

example.english: These shoes are suitable for walking on rocky paths.
example.chinese: 这双鞋适合在石头路上行走。

application.prompt: The guide chose a route ___ for beginners with little hiking experience. A. suitable B. suitably
application.solution: A。解析：route 前需要形容词 suitable；suitable for beginners 表示“适合初学者”。

collocations: a clear liquid; liquid soap; turn into a liquid
commonMistake: liquid 作名词可数也可作集合概念，作形容词时放在名词前；liquid 与 solid、gas 相对。

example.english: The medicine is a thick liquid with a sweet taste.
example.chinese: 这种药是一种甜味的黏稠液体。

application.prompt: At room temperature, water is a ___. A. liquefy B. liquid
application.solution: B。解析：a 后需要名词 liquid，表示“液体”；liquefy 是动词“使液化”。

grammar: adj. 便宜的；adv. 便宜地
collocations: a cheap ticket; buy sth cheap; cheap and cheerful
commonMistake: cheap 作形容词修饰商品；副词义可修饰 buy/get，比较级 cheaper；不要用 cheaply 修饰 be。

example.english: We found a cheap hotel near the railway station.
example.chinese: 我们在火车站附近找到一家便宜的旅馆。

application.prompt: The family bought a ___ table at the weekend market. A. cheap B. cheaply
application.solution: A。解析：table 前需要形容词 cheap；cheaply 是副词，不能修饰名词。

collocations: the creation of a new tool; a creative idea; a work of creation
commonMistake: creation 是名词，动词是 create，形容词是 creative；表示作品时可以说 a creation by the artist。

example.english: The paper dragon was Mei's creation for the school festival.
example.chinese: 这个纸龙是梅为校园节制作的作品。

application.prompt: The artist's latest ___ is a sculpture made from recycled metal. A. create B. creation
application.solution: B。解析：latest 后需要名词 creation，表示“最新作品”；create 是动词。

collocations: later on that day; see you later; sooner or later
commonMistake: later on 指之后某个时间；通常不与将来时间点 at 一起说 later on at Monday。

example.english: We visited the museum first and had lunch later on.
example.chinese: 我们先参观了博物馆，之后去吃了午饭。

application.prompt: The bus was full, so we took a taxi ___ and met the group at the hotel. A. later on B. later at
application.solution: A。解析：later on 表示“后来”；此处说之后乘出租车赶到酒店。

collocations: speed up the process; speed up to 60 km/h; speed up production
commonMistake: speed up 可作及物或不及物短语动词；过去式 speeded up 或 sped up 均可。

example.english: The new machine will speed up the process of sorting letters.
example.chinese: 这台新机器会加快信件分拣过程。

application.prompt: To finish before sunset, the workers had to ___ the packing process. A. fast up B. speed up
application.solution: B。解析：speed up the process 是“加快流程”；fast up 不是规范搭配。

grammar: adj. 阿拉伯的；n. 阿拉伯人
collocations: Arab culture; an Arab country; Arabs speak Arabic
commonMistake: Arab 可作形容词或可数名词；语言是 Arabic，不能把 Arab 与 Arabic 当成同一词性。

example.english: The library has a section on Arab history and culture.
example.chinese: 图书馆设有阿拉伯历史与文化专区。

application.prompt: The exhibition explores ___ architecture across several countries. A. Arab B. Arabic
application.solution: A。解析：architecture 前用形容词 Arab，表示“阿拉伯的建筑”；Arabic 是阿拉伯语或阿拉伯文的。

collocations: result in a delay; result in changes; serious injuries resulted from the crash
commonMistake: result in 后接结果；result from 后接原因，二者方向相反。

example.english: A blocked drain resulted in flooding after the heavy rain.
example.chinese: 暴雨后排水管堵塞，导致了洪水。

application.prompt: The team forgot to save its work, which may ___ the loss of an hour's effort. A. result from B. result in
application.solution: B。解析：result in 后接结果“损失一小时的努力”；result from 后接原因。

collocations: lead to a problem; lead to success; a path leads to the lake
commonMistake: lead to 可表示造成某结果，也可表示通向某地；lead 后不能直接接结果而省略 to。

example.english: Too little sleep can lead to trouble concentrating in class.
example.chinese: 睡眠太少会导致上课时难以集中注意力。

application.prompt: If the road is icy, driving too fast can ___ an accident. A. lead to B. lead for
application.solution: A。解析：lead to an accident 表示“导致事故”；句子说明超速在冰路上可能造成的后果。

collocations: give birth to a baby; date of birth; the birth of an idea
commonMistake: birth 是名词，动词是 bear；“出生于某地”用 be born in，不能说 be birth in。

example.english: The birth of the baby brought great joy to the family.
example.chinese: 这个宝宝的出生给家人带来了极大的喜悦。

application.prompt: The form asks for your place and date of ___. A. born B. birth
application.solution: B。解析：date of birth 是“出生日期”；born 是 bear 的过去分词，不能放在 of 后作名词。

collocations: grow rapidly; change rapidly; spread rapidly
commonMistake: rapidly 是副词，修饰动词；形容词是 rapid，不能用 rapid 修饰 move。

example.english: The small town has grown rapidly since the new road opened.
example.chinese: 新公路开通后，这座小镇发展迅速。

application.prompt: The ice melted ___ when the sun came out. A. rapidly B. rapid
application.solution: A。解析：melted 是动词，需用副词 rapidly 修饰；rapid 是形容词。

grammar: v. 买得起；承担得起；抽得出时间
collocations: afford a car; afford to travel; can't afford to wait
commonMistake: afford 后接名词或 to do；常用于 can/can't afford，表达经济或时间上的能力。

example.english: We cannot afford to replace the printer this month.
example.chinese: 我们这个月买不起一台新打印机。

application.prompt: The family saved for years so they could ___ their daughter's college fees. A. afford B. affordable
application.solution: A。解析：could 后接动词原形 afford，表示“有能力承担学费”；affordable 是形容词。

collocations: a technology company; keep sb company; in good company
commonMistake: company 作“陪伴”时通常不可数；作“公司”时可数。keep sb company 表示陪伴某人。

example.english: My aunt works for a company that designs solar panels.
example.chinese: 我姑姑在一家设计太阳能板的公司工作。

application.prompt: Grandpa asked me to stay and keep him ___ while he waited for the doctor. A. company B. companion
application.solution: A。解析：keep sb company 是“陪伴某人”的固定搭配；companion 指同伴，不能放在该短语中。

collocations: sticky tape; a sticky floor; sticky weather
commonMistake: sticky 可形容表面黏，也可形容天气闷热；副词是 stickily，名词是 stickiness。

example.english: The juice made the table sticky, so we wiped it at once.
example.chinese: 果汁把桌面弄黏了，所以我们马上擦干净。

application.prompt: The hot, humid afternoon felt uncomfortable and ___. A. stick B. sticky
application.solution: B。解析：felt 后用形容词 sticky 描述天气闷热；stick 是名词“棍子”或动词“粘”。

collocations: a school songbook; a songbook of folk music; read from a songbook
commonMistake: songbook 是由 song 与 book 构成的可数名词；复数 songbooks。

example.english: The choir shared one songbook during the rehearsal.
example.chinese: 合唱团排练时共用了一本歌本。

application.prompt: Each singer opened the ___ to find the words for the next song. A. songbook B. songwriter
application.solution: A。解析：查找歌词要翻开 songbook（歌本）；songwriter 是写歌的人。

collocations: mass production; film production; production costs
commonMistake: production 是名词，动词是 produce；production of sth 表示某物的生产，不能写成 produce of sth。

example.english: The factory reduced plastic production by using recycled material.
example.chinese: 这家工厂通过使用回收材料减少了塑料产量。

application.prompt: The ___ of electric buses has increased this year. A. produce B. production
application.solution: B。解析：句子主语需要名词 production（生产/产量）；produce 是动词或农产品。

collocations: change gradually; gradually become; increase gradually
commonMistake: gradually 是副词，形容词是 gradual；副词修饰动词时常放在动词后或句首。

example.english: The sky gradually became brighter as the storm passed.
example.chinese: 暴风雨过去后，天空逐渐亮了起来。

application.prompt: With daily practice, her pronunciation improved ___. A. gradual B. gradually
application.solution: B。解析：improved 是动词，需用副词 gradually 修饰；gradual 是形容词。

collocations: widely used; widely known; vary widely
commonMistake: widely 常修饰 used、known、accepted 等词；形容词 wide 表示“宽的”，不能说 widely road。

example.english: Solar panels are now widely used in sunny regions.
example.chinese: 太阳能板如今在阳光充足的地区得到广泛使用。

application.prompt: English is ___ spoken in many international airports. A. widely B. wide
application.solution: A。解析：spoken 前用副词 widely，表示“被广泛使用”；wide 是形容词。

grammar: 短语 试图找到做某事的方法；打算做某事
collocations: be looking to improve; be looking to hire; look to do sth
commonMistake: be looking to do sth 后接动词原形，表示计划或希望采取行动；look for sth 才是“寻找某物”。

example.english: The company is looking to hire two more engineers this year.
example.chinese: 这家公司打算今年再招聘两名工程师。

application.prompt: The school is ___ reduce food waste in the cafeteria this term. A. looking for reduce B. looking to reduce
application.solution: B。解析：be looking to reduce 表示“打算减少”；look for 后要接名词或动名词，不接动词原形。

collocations: a glider pilot; fly a glider; a paper glider
commonMistake: glider 是由 glide 加 -r 构成的名词，指无动力或少动力的滑翔机；glide 是动词“滑翔”。

example.english: The glider circled above the valley without an engine.
example.chinese: 滑翔机没有发动机，在山谷上空盘旋。

application.prompt: Unlike a powered plane, a ___ can stay aloft by riding rising air. A. glider B. glide
application.solution: A。解析：能借上升气流飞行的飞行器是 glider；glide 是“滑翔”这一动作。

grammar: adj. 三维的；n. 三维影像
collocations: 3D film; 3D printer; watch a film in 3D
commonMistake: 3D 是 three-dimensional 的缩写，作名词或定语时通常保留大写 D；读作 three-D。

example.english: The children wore special glasses to watch the 3D film.
example.chinese: 孩子们戴上特制眼镜观看这部 3D 电影。

application.prompt: The model looked realistic because it was printed with a ___ printer. A. three dimensions B. 3D
application.solution: B。解析：3D printer 是“三维打印机”；形容词缩写 3D 放在 printer 前作定语。

grammar: 缩写 公元（公元纪年）
collocations: the year 120 CE; dates in CE; BCE and CE
commonMistake: CE 是 Common Era 的缩写，写在年份后；它与 BCE（公元前）相对，纪年方式与 AD 对应。

example.english: The ancient coin was made around 200 CE.
example.chinese: 这枚古钱币大约铸造于公元 200 年。

application.prompt: The inscription dates the temple to 350 ___, meaning 350 years in the Common Era. A. CE B. BCE
application.solution: A。解析：CE 表示公元纪年；350 BCE 则是公元前 350 年，与句意相反。
